channel.title: Comments on: Peeking in on Nature’s Hoodwink

item.title: By: Jeff
item.dc:creator: Jeff
item.description: Thanks Carl. I like your writing of this and agree with it. As having experienced life as an empirical truth, only known of that, and now, finding out this existence I live has been, at least by view, a way of things, known and unknown, and not known, to by the way, be viewed as a truth. Thanks for further enlightenment. In simplicity, sometimes the way seeks, yet can run away. By non-actions, the way will be, whether the way is, or is not.
